faqs.question: Is NextStep Navigator really free?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100% free. No signups, no credit card, no hidden fees. It's built as a public good to help students make informed career decisions. We don't sell data, don't run ads, and don't upsell premium tiers.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an account?
faqs.answer: No account needed. Just enter your name and select your user type (Student, Graduate, or Professional) — that's it. Your data lives only in your browser and clears when you close the tab.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right user type?
faqs.answer: Pick based on your current stage, not your goal. If you're in school (Grades 8–12), pick Student. If you've finished a degree and are job-hunting or studying further, pick Graduate. If you're already working and exploring a switch, pick Working Professional.

faqs.question: How are careers in the Career Bank chosen?
faqs.answer: Careers span 7 industries — Technology, Healthcare, Business, Creative, Engineering, Education, and Government. Each was hand-curated based on current job market data, salary reports, and real professional journeys. We prioritize careers with clear growth paths and accessible entry routes.

faqs.question: How does the Interest Quiz work?
faqs.answer: The quiz has 4 tracks (Science, Commerce, Arts, Technology), each with 8 questions. Every answer is tagged with personality traits — analytical, creative, helping, etc. At the end, we aggregate your traits, pick your top one, and map it to a recommended stream plus matching careers.

faqs.question: Can I save careers for later?
faqs.answer: Yes. Click the heart icon on any career card to bookmark it. You can also add personal notes to each bookmark — perfect for jotting down 'Why this interests me' or 'Questions to research'. Export your entire shortlist as a .txt file or share it via the native share sheet.

faqs.question: What is the Career Passport?
faqs.answer: The Career Passport is your progress tracker. As you explore — bookmarking careers, completing quizzes, visiting pages — you unlock badges like Explorer, Curator, Voyager, and Scholar. It gamifies the exploration and gives you a sense of momentum. View it on your Profile page.

faqs.question: Is my data stored anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. All data lives in your browser (localStorage for bookmarks and notes, sessionStorage for your profile). Nothing is sent to any server. We don't have a backend, database, or tracking scripts. Close your tab and everything is gone — except bookmarks, which persist locally on your device.

faqs.question: Does the site work offline?
faqs.answer: Mostly yes. It's built as a Progressive Web App (PWA), so once loaded, most features work offline. Google Maps and YouTube embeds require internet, but career browsing, quizzes, and reading resources work without a connection — great for career fairs and rural schools.

faqs.question: Can I delete everything I've saved?
faqs.answer: Yes. Go to Bookmarks → click 'Clear' to wipe all bookmarks and notes. Or clear your browser's local storage for a complete reset. We recommend exporting your bookmarks as .txt first if you want to keep a copy.

faqs.question: The information on careers — is it current?
faqs.answer: Careers data reflects the Indian/US job market as of 2025–2026. Salary ranges are indicative and vary by city, company size, and experience. We update content periodically, but always cross-check with official sources like Naukri, LinkedIn, and industry salary reports before making major decisions.

faqs.question: Can I contribute or suggest a career?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Use the Feedback form to suggest a career, report an issue, or share a success story. We read every message and incorporate suggestions where possible.
